data.name: weekly_slots_one_per_weekday

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "muscle_group" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plans" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "training_blocks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "plan_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES plans (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "duration_weeks" INTEGER NULL, "end_date" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_templates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "plan_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES plans (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "weekly_slots" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "block_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES training_blocks (id), "weekday" INTEGER NOT NULL, "session_template_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session_templates (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercise_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "session_template_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session_templates (id), "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "order_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "superset_group" INTEGER NULL, "rest_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "planned_sets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "exercise_entry_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercise_entries (id), "order_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weight" REAL NULL, "reps" INTEGER NULL, "duration_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "target_intensity" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "repeat_groups" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "session_template_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session_templates (id), "order_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "repeat_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "intensity_labels" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "endurance_blocks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "session_template_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session_templates (id), "repeat_group_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES repeat_groups (id), "order_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "role" INTEGER NOT NULL, "measure" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_value" INTEGER NOT NULL, "intensity_label_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES intensity_labels (id), "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "week_overrides" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "block_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES training_blocks (id), "week_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weekday" INTEGER NOT NULL, "action" INTEGER NOT NULL, "replacement_session_template_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES session_templates (id), "load_multiplier" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "occurrence_moves" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "block_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES training_blocks (id), "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "plan_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES plans (id), "block_id" TEXT NULL, "session_template_id" TEXT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" INTEGER NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "total_duration_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "planned_snapshot" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "logged_exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "session_log_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session_logs (id), "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "order_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "superset_group" INTEGER NULL, "skipped" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("skipped" IN (0, 1)), "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "logged_sets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "logged_exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES logged_exercises (id), "order_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" INTEGER NOT NULL, "planned_weight" REAL NULL, "planned_reps" INTEGER NULL, "planned_duration_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "planned_intensity" REAL NULL, "actual_weight" REAL NULL, "actual_reps" INTEGER NULL, "actual_duration_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "actual_intensity" REAL NULL, "completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("completed" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "logged_blocks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "session_log_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session_logs (id), "order_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "round_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "role" INTEGER NOT NULL, "measure" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_value" INTEGER NOT NULL, "intensity_label" TEXT NULL, "actual_duration_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "actual_distance_meters" INTEGER NULL, "completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("completed" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings_rows" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "unit_weight" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_distance" INTEGER NOT NULL, "intensity_scale" INTEGER NOT NULL, "default_rest_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "audio_cues" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("audio_cues" IN (0, 1)), "vibration" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("vibration" IN (0, 1)), "theme_mode" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX weekly_slots_one_per_weekday ON weekly_slots (block_id, weekday) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
